limits: the verifier evaluates the polynomials itself: the identity and its bound, not a succinct proof
name: W12_schwartz_zippel_trace

provenance.source: The Gödel Method: Research and Development Handover (2026-10-22), W-12

statement: Over F_p the trace identity decides a whole instruction at once: on 3 instructions, all rows of the honest trace satisfy the constraints exactly when X^N - 1 divides the composition polynomial, checked at one random point (3 accepted); one flipped gate output in one row breaks divisibility and is rejected (3 of 3). Error bound 2N/p.
